==Walkthrough==
{{checklist|
* Inspect the empty display case in the north-east corner of the [[Grand Museum]] in [[Civitas illa Fortis]] to start the quest{{Chat option|1Yes.}}
* Talk to [[Curator Herminius]] in the middle of the museum. Talk about the empty display case{{Chat option|4Could you tell me more about that empty display?}}
* Investigate the tools behind the display case.
* Inspect the display case again.
* Talk to the citizens, academics, and tourists around the room about their suspicions until one mentions a mysterious individual.
* Talk to [[Regulus Cento]] by the quetzals south-west of the museum{{chat option|2Have you seen anybody suspicious around?}}
* Go east and talk to a [[Trader Crewmember]] (charter ship crewmember) about the suspicious man (1 inventory space required) {{chat option|4Have you seen a man with a case?|1As long as it is just the one favour...}}
* Go to the crafting shop south-east and get the sail repaired by [[Artima]]{{Chat option|2I was hoping for some help.|1Go on then.}}
* Go back to the Trader Crewmember and talk about the suspicious man again{{chat option|4So, about that man with the case}}
* Head to [[Port Sarim]], then talk to [[Trader Stan]] or any of the Trader Crewmembers who are located at the most south dock{{chat option|4Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?}}
* Talk to [[Betty]] in the runeshop in north-west Port Sarim{{chat option|2Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?}}
* Read the note you receive
* Talk to Curator Haig Halen in [[Varrock Museum]] about Xerna's Diadem{{chat option|1I'm looking for Xerna's Diadem.}} - Option 2 if Bone Voyage is complete
* Pickpocket him for the [[Storeroom key (Ethically Acquired Antiquities)|storeroom key]].
* Open the storeroom in the north-east part of the museum and search the crates.
* Go back and talk to Haig Halen selecting option 1 to begin the scene{{chat option|1I found Xerna's Diadem...}} - Option 2 if Bone Voyage is complete
* Select options that will shame Haig Halen. A full list of which options to select can be found in the in-depth guide.
* Return to the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis and talk to Curator Herminius to complete the quest{{chat option|4About that empty display...}} }}
